writeup: TIC 156776551 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 3.3936 days. Analysis of TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse that dims the system by 22.63%, along with a secondary eclipse detected at 5.6 sigma significance near orbital phase 0.49. The binary light-curve signal achieves a detection significance of 132.0 using the Box Least Squares method. Pixel-level difference imaging confirms the signal originates near the target location, with a peak signal-to-noise of 43.9, though with a centroid offset of 3.8 arcseconds. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it may be previously unrecorded. The pipeline's machine learning model assigns it a screening score of 0.30, and the data passed all quality checks without flags.
